verdict.rationale: Fellow's docs say little about how transcription works. The only quality statement is the marketing line "human-level accuracy" (fellow-docs-51). Beyond that, the API docs say recordings carry diarized, timestamped transcripts (fellow-docs-36), and capture can run with or without a bot (fellow-docs-20). This barely goes past "AI-powered". Missing for 10: named transcription models, quantified or benchmarked accuracy figures (e.g., WER per language), documented known limits (accents, crosstalk, audio quality, language support), and independent or hands-on accuracy corroboration.
